title: Optimize your last mile operations
body: You've optimized your logistics operations, but what about the aspect that costs many carriers a significant amount of revenue?

metrics.body: 850M hours B2B, 160M hours B2C, every year. 1–1.5 avoidable hours per truck per day; $6 billion in lost carrier revenue. An unattended endpoint takes dwell to zero because nobody waits for anybody.

1 in 6 US deliveries fails first attempt; 1 in 9 because nobody was there. Of 23 billion US parcels, 15% are re-delivered and 1.5% lost or stolen; McKinsey attributes 10.75 points of that 16.5% to blind handoffs, about 2.5 billion parcels a year. Re-delivery alone costs carriers 1–3% of revenue.

70% of dispatcher and service time spent on handoff failures. Around 56,000 US dispatchers and agents; driver apps run $20–45 per driver per month. Veranda's requirement of no driver app and no key is the answer to McKinsey's "minimum personnel time" criterion.
